_comment: The knowledge registry (Slice 6.11): declarative expectations about what exists in the world and how it relates — NEVER how to read a document (the parser anti-goal). Each entry names a universal mechanism ('given'), the document to pursue in plain words, and the jurisdictions it holds in ('*' = everywhere). Seeded deliberately small — only what this vault's own evidence can raise (resist encyclopedism; the tiers grow it). Versioned like every other data pack: edit by adding expectations-v2.json.
